rejectionGroups.reason: These tops are oversized graphic merchandise dominated by cartoons, slogans, pseudo-brand text, skulls, distressed prints or uncontrolled length and cannot support a clean modern Zara-led wardrobe.
The distressed Liberty graphic hoodie is costume-led, damaged, oversized and too dark and theatrical for a versatile modern wardrobe.
The long asymmetric distressed denim short is product-only, heavily ripped and visually dated.
These photographed trousers are visibly extremely wide, synthetic, cargo-heavy or puddled at the shoe and fail the controlled silhouette gate.
These product-only bottoms are wide, ballooned, cargo-heavy, distressed, paint-splattered, slogan-led or otherwise novelty-driven and lack credible clean on-body fit proof.

qaSummary: 40 identities and all 103 recorded color images loaded for full visual review.
Nothing passed: every top was oversized graphic merchandise and every bottom was distressed, extremely wide, puddled, cargo-heavy, novelty-led or insufficiently proven.
No candidate warranted a variant shortlist or final approval board, and no new identity, variant or image entered the usable pool.
